account.description: The Fyniq account's code; the workbook's accounts that map onto it are added.

decision.description: The Accountant's decision on the line; absent while undecided.

fyniq.description: Fyniq's figure in the base currency, debit positive.

key.description: The line's key in the difference register: the Fyniq account's code, the month (YYYY-MM) and the figure, or the code and opening.

kind.description: opening: the balance at the books start; movement: the month's; closing: the balance at the month's end; receivable or payable: what the contact owes or is owed at the as-of, by the AR & AP sheet (rev 0.267); payroll_net, payroll_statutory, payroll_cost: a month's net pay, what is due to the CPF Board (CPF, SDL, SHG) and the employer's cost, by the Payroll sheet.

month.description: The month (YYYY-MM); absent for the opening.

proposed_class.description: The class proposed (design D8): a, a cent allocation on a spread or depreciation account within a cent a month; b, a deliberate rule change on a revaluation or statutory account; empty when none fits, for the Accountant to decide.

workbook.description: The workbook's, from its Trial Balance sheet after RND-IMPORT.
